high_level_description: stc brand style, a vintage-style televised photograph of a man speaking at a desk in front of a chalkboard, framed by a TV screen border.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A green chalkboard with Arabic text in the top right corner, flat even lighting typical of 1970s-80s television production, and a rounded television-frame border.

elements.desc: A middle-aged Middle Eastern man wearing glasses, a brown plaid blazer over a beige collared shirt, and a red and white checkered keffiyeh, gesturing with his right hand while speaking.
Arabic text visible on the chalkboard in the top right corner.
